name: Ribbon Masjid
summary: One broad architectural ribbon joins a minaret, dome, and open entrance in a warm contemporary mark.
why: The path traces a complete mosque, moving from the minaret through the dome and returning around a large doorway. A copper segment closes the base like a welcoming threshold. Rounded joints soften the structure without losing its Islamic silhouette.
risk: The continuous outline has more detail than a solid silhouette. The wide doorway is intentionally oversized to survive at launcher size.
sub2: An invitation to come to prayer
reasonToChoose: You want an unmistakable mosque with a softer modern line.
